goal: Prevent duplicate manual P2P connections to the same target during concurrent connection attempts
Avoids opening redundant connections when startup options overlap or addnode commands race
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by testing functional suite, unit tests, and failure modes (8144225309)
Verified on I2P that concurrent addnode onetry no longer opens duplicate connections (Bicaru20)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case race condition opening duplicate connections to manual targets
The benefit is limited to nodes with overlapping startup arguments or concurrent addnode calls
